description: Translate the next scene of story dialogue after Spadamon is rescued.

english:
We’re with you!
We’ll fight by
your side!
Let’s go!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Spadamon!! I’m
glad you’re
safe!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Ba... Badamon!
Bada-mooon!!
Thank goodness!
I thought you
were dead!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Hey! Don’t say
something so
awful! You got
away from those
ROG guys too,
Spadamon! And
who are these
Digimon...? Um,
who are you?
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
We’re Xros
Heart! We came
from another
Zone. Spadamon
said he wanted
to save you, so
we decided to
help!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
I see... So
that’s what
happened. Thank
you so much!
You’re an
amazing team!
I’m glad you
were here to
protect
Spadamon. If
ROG had caught
him, things
would have been
much, much
worse!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Worse...? Wait,
that guy we
just beat said
all of ROG was
looking for
Spadamon...
What does that
mean?
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
I... I don’t
know either!
I’ve actually
lost my
memories... I
can’t remember
anything from
before I
started living
with Patamon.
Maybe I know
the secret of
this Zone...
H-hey, I’m only
joking!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Hey, hey, hey!
Are you okay?!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
But... ROG
sounds like a
pretty big
organization.
It can’t be for
nothing if
they’re
searching with
this many
people.
Spadamon, you
really don’t
remember
anything?
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
B-but I really
don’t
remember...
Everyone says
I’ll remember
naturally once
I get stronger,
but I’ve been
running away
all this time,
so I never get
stronger...
Heh!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Grrr! I’ve had
enough! Taiki
and I will
toughen you up,
whether you
like it or not!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Ha ha! I can’t
tell if you’re
strong or weak.
But the voice
that called us
here was real.
I could feel
how badly you
wanted to save
your friends!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Oh, right! We
can talk later!
Those ROG guys
started up the
DigiLab
system...
They’re going
to run a fusion
experiment in
the Central
Room next door!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Hmm? What do
you mean,
fusion? Is it
DigiXross?
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
...DigiXross?
No, the DigiLab
combines
Digimon to make
them even
stronger! It’s
a really useful
system when
it’s used
properly. But
those guys
don’t know how
it works...
They’ll force
your
square-shaped
friend into the
experiment!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
I’m coming with
you, too! Let’s
hurry to the
Central Room!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Why’d they
bring such a
huge lump here?
He’s heavy,
big, and looks
slow. Stubborn
and hard to
handle, too.
And besides,
our
personalities
kind of
overlap...
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
How do they?!
We’re not even
one micron
alike!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Oh, shut up,
all of you!
Hurry up and
carry him over
to that
machine! I’m
going to absorb
his power and
bulk! No one’s
ever calling me
a chicken
again!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Hey... There
are two
machines here.
Which one is
it?
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
W-which one...?
How should I
know? The
database only
says it’s a
machine here.
Almost all the
Digimon ran
off, so we
can’t ask them.
Maybe we should
catch that
Spadamon and
squeeze the
answer out of
him...?
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
Idiot! If you
find him, hand
him over to
Lord
Minotaurmon!
Figure this out
yourselves.
Think of a
clue!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
I think it’s a
secret system
found only in
this Zone. It
mixes Digimon
together and
makes them a
lot stronger.
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
If you touch
the switch in
front of the
machine... it
lights up with
a flash and
goes beep-boop!
That’s what I
heard.
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
...So which of
these two looks
like that
machine?
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
They both kind
of look like
it... Actually,
neither one
really does.
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
What’s with all
this ‘flash’
and ‘beep-boop’
stuff? Are you
messing with
me? That’s not
a clue at all!
How am I
supposed to
tell? Whatever,
just try one!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
You’re talking
like it’s
someone else’s
problem! What
if you mess
with it and
combine them
the wrong way?
If you’re so
sure, you two
try it! One’s
squishy and
one’s
rock-hard. Put
them together
and divide by
two, and you’ll
get a nice,
soft result!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.

english:
You’re the one
talking
nonsense,
birdbrain! Keep
spouting that
garbage and
I’ll pluck that
crest right off
your head!
blocks.review_note: Dialogue translated directly from the Japanese scene; character names and DigiLab/DigiXross terminology follow project style.
